newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's military urges quick solution to crisis.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's military urges quick solution to crisis.

text.p: Ecuador's military called on Friday for a quick solution to the political crisis and chaos that erupted after Congress voted to oust President Abdala Bucaram, who defiantly pledged to remain in office.
"A solution cannot be awaited for too long," armed forces chief Gen. Paco Moncayo said after he and other senior military officials met behind closed doors with Bucaram at the presidential palace.

He was referring not only to Bucaram's standoff with Fabian Alarcon -- the congressional leader appointed by his fellow lawmakers to serve as interim president -- but to the fact that Vice President Rosalia Arteaga had also staked a claim to the presidency.
In his statement, Moncayo stressed that the Ecuadorean military was "absolutely apolitical" and would not move to fill the powerful void left by Bucaram's ouster.
But he said the military could serve as a potential mediator in the conflict and hold out "bridges of understanding and dialogue" between opposing political factions.
"Today, more than ever, unity between the people and armed forces can help us overcome this critical hour," the statement said.
